title: Tight Security Bounds for t-Round KAF Ciphers
summary: An upper-bound attack and separate lower bounds are known for t-round KAF ciphers, but tight security bounds for arbitrary t remain open.

formal_statement.body: Determine tight security bounds for $t$-round Key-Alternating Feistel (KAF) ciphers; the precise bounds for this round-parameterized cipher remain unresolved.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key block-cipher security for Key-Alternating Feistel networks.
parameters: t: number of rounds in the KAF cipher
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine tight security bounds for t-round KAF ciphers.

citations.label: Revisiting Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers for Shorter Keys and Multi-user Security

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents tight security bounds for t-round KAF as an open problem. It reports an upper-bound attack and separate lower bounds without a tight characterization for arbitrary t.
citation_labels: Chun Guo et al., Revisiting Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers for Shorter Keys and Multi-user Security
